title: How to disable auto translate to English?
body: Hi! I'm trying to figure out how to disable automatic speech translation into English. What should I do to get the text in the original language? Thanks
author: fat4lix

comments.body: Hello! This is a known issue with Whisper models. We are looking into this.

@fat4lix 
I've added `--language` parameter in `run-server.sh` to avoid translation to English, e.g.
```
# Run the server
./whisper-server \
    --model "$MODEL" \
    --host "$HOST" \
    --port "$PORT" \
    --diarize \
    --language fr \
    --print-progress
```

It's working for me
Closing this issue as @lelostsamurai 's suggestion works.
This solution will cause all timestamps to display as 0.0-1.0, just asking, are there any plans to support multiple languages?

title: Microphone Input Handling Improvement
body:
## Description
Users are experiencing issues with microphone input detection and audio quality. While some cases are related to system settings, the application should better handle audio input configuration and provide clear feedback.

## Impact
- Users unable to record audio effectively
- Unclear whether issue is system or application related
- Poor user experience during recording setup

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Clear feedback on microphone detection status
2. Visual indicator of audio input levels
3. Troubleshooting guide in UI for common audio issues
4. Automatic detection of system audio settings
5. Warning if input volume is too low

## Priority
High - Affects core recording functionality
author: athulchandroth

comments.body: The bug was caused by some permission issues and is fixed and added raised a PR to devtest branch Once @athulchandroth reviews it and approve, we can merge.

comments.body:
Thanks for sharing the logs. I see you're encountering permission errors while trying to build whisper.cpp. 

```
make[1]: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/make: Permission denied
make[1]: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/make: Permission denied
```

This error messages means that the make command doesn't have sufficient permissions to access the CommandLineTools directory. 

This is a common issue that can be resolved by changing the make command with sudo privileges.

To fix this, you might have to build whisper.cpp as sudo user. Please see the command below

```
sudo ./build_whisper.sh 
```

Please let me know if this worked.
